app_info.subtitle: Pay-per-use APIs for agents
app_info.description: Locus gives an agent one prepaid credit balance for its paid work: cited web research, data and API lookups from a contracted provider catalog, executable cost quotes, and idempotent billing - a retry that reuses its idempotency key replays the stored outcome instead of charging again. The agent searches the catalog in plain English, inspects one endpoint's schema and price, optionally locks an exact quote, and executes by slug; every charge returns the exact credits debited and the remaining balance, and workspace owners control spend limits and approvals from the Locus dashboard.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the enabled catalog index and returns ranked matches with slugs and prices; it cannot execute, enable, or modify anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches Locus's own catalog index and contacts no external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns search results only and changes no state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one endpoint's input schema, example, output shape, and price without invoking it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Locus catalog metadata only; no external calls.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds or removes the selected endpoint as a typed tool on the authenticated workspace, so it changes a workspace preference.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only private Locus workspace configuration and does not publish to or modify an external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes a reversible pin preference without deleting data, executing the endpoint, or charging credits.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a bounded page of the connection's enabled endpoints without invoking any of them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the Locus catalog only; no external calls.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the authenticated connection's remaining credit balance and status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Locus ledger state only; no external calls.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads a balance and changes no state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Re-reads a bounded chunk of a previously stored call result by its receipt ID without re-running the call.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads stored results from Locus only; no external calls.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads a stored result and never creates a new charge.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived executable price approval on the server, so it is not purely a read, but it never charges credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: May probe a live upstream quote to price a variable-cost endpoint exactly, without paying it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Never charges or removes anything; an unused approval simply expires.

justifications.read_only_justification: Invalidates a stored price approval, which is a state change rather than a read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on Locus-stored approvals only; no external calls.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently invalidates the referenced unused approval so it can no longer authorize an execution; no credits are involved.

justifications.read_only_justification: Spends prepaid credits and runs the selected endpoint, so it is a billed action rather than a read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Invokes external provider APIs from the Locus catalog and returns their responses.
justifications.destructive_justification: Debits credits from the prepaid balance for each non-replayed call; retries with the same idempotency key replay the stored outcome instead of charging again.

test_cases.description: Discover a capability by outcome: the user asks for research or search APIs, and the app searches the enabled catalog and returns ranked, priced matches. Fixture: the dedicated sample-only Locus Review workspace reached through the supplied OAuth credentials; pre-funded balance, 1 credit = $0.001, and these enabled slugs: brave/answers, x402-api-exa-ai-search/call, x402-api-exa-ai-contents/call.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the enabled APIs through Locus that can answer research questions or search the web. Return exact slugs and current prices. Do not execute any paid tool.
test_cases.expected_output: A short ranked list containing the enabled research and search matches, including brave/answers, x402-api-exa-ai-search/call, and x402-api-exa-ai-contents/call, with exact slugs, summaries, and current catalog prices; no charge is made.

test_cases.description: Inspect one live endpoint before calling it: the user asks for the exact input schema and current price of brave/answers. Fixture: the dedicated sample-only Locus Review workspace with brave/answers enabled and a funded prepaid balance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the input schema, an example call, and the current exact price for brave/answers on Locus. Do not execute it.
test_cases.expected_output: The live brave/answers schema: required messages array of {role, content} objects; optional model, stream, and max_completion_tokens fields; an example invocation; output information; and the current fixed catalog price (96 credits / $0.096 at submission). No charge is made.

test_cases.description: Check remaining prepaid credits before paid work. Fixture: the dedicated sample-only Locus Review workspace, pre-funded with 25,000 credits and holding 24,904 credits after one verified 96-credit test call at submission; 1 credit = $0.001.
test_cases.user_prompt: How many Locus credits do I have left on this workspace?
test_cases.expected_output: The current credit balance with its denomination (1 credit = $0.001) and active status, with no charge made.

test_cases.description: Quote without spending: the user supplies the exact brave/answers body, requests a binding price, explicitly forbids execution, and asks the app to cancel the unused approval. Fixture: the dedicated funded Locus Review workspace with brave/answers enabled.
test_cases.user_prompt: On Locus, describe brave/answers, then quote exactly what a call with the body {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the x402 payment protocol?"}]} would cost. Do not run it, and cancel the quote after reporting it.
test_cases.expected_output: A binding quote equal to the endpoint's current catalog price (96 credits / $0.096 at submission), with an approval reference, followed by confirmation that the approval was cancelled; the credit balance is unchanged.

test_cases.description: End-to-end paid call using the live brave/answers endpoint: the app confirms the schema and price, executes one request, reports the answer, exact charge, and remaining balance, and includes source URLs only if the upstream response actually returns them. Fixture: dedicated funded Locus Review workspace with brave/answers enabled.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Locus, first describe brave/answers and confirm its current price and schema, then execute it for the query "What is the x402 payment protocol?" using the required messages format. Return any citations actually supplied, the exact credits charged, and the remaining balance.
test_cases.expected_output: A substantive answer from brave/answers; any citations actually present in the upstream response, without inventing missing sources; the exact live charge from response metadata (96 credits / $0.096 at submission); and the remaining Locus balance. This exact flow was verified successfully before submission.

negative_test_cases.description: A documentation question about the app itself should be answered from knowledge, not by invoking catalog tools or spending credits.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how the Locus app works and what its tools are for.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because this is a documentation question rather than a request to use its tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Account administration is not exposed through these tools; the app should direct the user to the Locus dashboard instead of attempting it.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change my Locus account password and update the billing email on my workspace.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because account administration is outside its exposed tool workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Purchasing credits is not available through the app; the app should decline and point to the workspace dashboard rather than initiate any purchase or checkout flow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy $50 of Locus credits for me right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because purchasing credits is not available through its tools.
